age.evidence: Male Wistar rats (180-200 g, n = 64) were purchased from Charles River Laboratories International, Inc. (Germany) — only body weight, not age, is stated.

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin ... was dissolved at a concentration of 1 mg/ml in sterile saline solution (0.9% NaCl) and administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at 0.32 mg/kg of body weight.

The selective 5-HT2BR antagonist RS-127445 ... was dissolved in a vehicle consisting of Tween80:polyethylene glycol:physiological saline (0.9% NaCl) in a ratio of 5:5:90. The antagonist or its vehicle was administered i.p. ... we used 3 doses of RS-127445 (0.32, 1.0, or 3.2 mg/kg)

handling.evidence: No general handling-habituation protocol is described; only procedure-specific acclimation is mentioned ('animals were acclimated to the procedure by taking rectal temperature measurements several times before the study began').

group_housing.evidence: Rats were housed two per cage at 22 ± 1°C under a 12-hour light-dark cycle with free access to food and water (ad libitum).

day_night_flipped.evidence: Behavioral testing was performed in the morning during the light phase. ... housed ... under a 12-hour light-dark cycle

enrichment_housing.evidence: Animals were habituated to these housing conditions (i.e., standard cages without environmental enrichment) for 2 weeks before the start of the experiments.

assays.assay_description: Rats were placed in a 45 × 45 × 45 cm open field arena immediately after psilocybin/saline injection (30 min after RS-127445 or vehicle pretreatment) and video-recorded for 30 min. Mobility time, distance traveled (cm) and velocity (cm/s) were quantified with EthoVision XT 15.

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at 0.32 mg/kg of body weight

setup_habituation.evidence: Immediately after the single injection of psilocybin or saline ... rats were placed in an Open Field arena; no prior apparatus exposure is described.

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed in an Open Field arena (45 cm × 45 cm × 45 cm), and their behavior was recorded with a camera device for 30 minutes.

food_restriction.evidence: Testing took place in a bare open field arena ('The arena was thoroughly cleaned with 70% ethanol and dried between test sessions'); home-cage food was ad libitum but no food was present during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: No water was present in the open field arena during the 30-min recording; home cage access was ad libitum.

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after the single injection of psilocybin or saline—that is, 30 minutes after the pretreatment with RS-127445 or vehicle—rats were placed in an Open Field arena

sample_size.evidence: the experiment utilized 8 experimental groups (n = 8 per group)

outcomes.summary: Neither psilocybin (0.32 mg/kg) nor RS-127445 pretreatment (0.32, 1.0, 3.2 mg/kg) altered locomotor activity in the open field: mobility time, distance traveled and velocity were unchanged across the eight groups.
outcomes.statistics: Mobility time: Antagonist F(3,55)=0.47, p=0.71; Agonist F(1,55)=3.95, p=0.052; Interaction F(3,55)=0.26, p=0.85. Distance: Antagonist F(3,55)=0.58, p=0.63; Agonist F(1,55)=2.11, p=0.15; Interaction F(3,55)=0.82, p=0.49. Velocity: Antagonist F(3,55)=0.58, p=0.63; Agonist F(1,55)=2.12, p=0.15; Interaction F(3,55)=0.82, p=0.49.
outcomes.evidence: Data showed no significant differences between groups on mobility time ... distance traveled ... and velocity.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The rats' movements were quantified as mobility time, distance traveled (cm), and velocity (cm/s)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only session totals/means are reported (Data are plotted as means ± SEM); no within-session time binning described.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition, sequence or bout-structure analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only locomotor measures (mobility time, distance, velocity) were scored; locomotor distance is not an ethological behaviour.

B5_social.evidence: Rats were tested individually in the open field arena.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Open field locomotion requires no learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: using EthoVision XT 15 tracking software (Noldus Information Technology) — position tracking only.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Data were analyzed by two-way ANOVA on separate measures; no PCA/clustering reported.

E1_environment_type.evidence: rats were placed in an Open Field arena (45 cm × 45 cm × 45 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: Bare open field arena; no shelter described. Definitionally absent.

E3_bedding.evidence: The arena was thoroughly cleaned with 70% ethanol and dried between test sessions; no bedding described.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material described in the arena.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No objects described in the open field arena.

E6_spatial.evidence: Open Field arena (45 cm × 45 cm × 45 cm) — single undivided space.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat was placed alone in the arena, cleaned between test sessions.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the arena during the 30-min recording.

D1_continuity.evidence: their behavior was recorded with a camera device for 30 minutes (one session, day 0)

D2_session_duration.evidence: recorded with a camera device for 30 minutes

D3_recording_days.evidence: Immediately after injection (0 minute), rats were placed in the open field (OF) arena — day 0 only.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug open field recording reported.

D5_followup.evidence: Open field was recorded only on the injection day; no ≥24 h follow-up session.

assays.assay_description: During the same 30-min open field session (45 × 45 × 45 cm arena) starting immediately after psilocybin/saline injection, head shakes and/or whole-body shakes were manually counted (number of bouts) by a blinded experimenter.

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at 0.32 mg/kg of body weight

setup_habituation.evidence: Rats were placed in the open field immediately after injection; no prior apparatus habituation described.

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed in an Open Field arena ... and their behavior was recorded with a camera device for 30 minutes.

food_restriction.evidence: No food present in the open field arena during the 30-min HTR scoring window; home-cage food ad libitum.

water_restriction.evidence: No water present in the open field arena during the 30-min recording; home-cage water ad libitum.

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after injection (0 minute), rats were placed in the open field (OF) arena to assess the head-twitch response (HTR)

sample_size.evidence: the experiment utilized 8 experimental groups (n = 8 per group)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (0.32 mg/kg) significantly increased the number of head-twitch bouts relative to saline-treated rats. Pretreatment with the 5-HT2B antagonist RS-127445 (0.32, 1.0 or 3.2 mg/kg) did not block this effect at any dose.
outcomes.statistics: Kruskal-Wallis H = 44.63, p < 0.0001; post hoc vs VEH-SAL: p < 0.05, p < 0.05, p < 0.01, p < 0.05 for VEH-PSI, RS0.32-PSI, RS1.0-PSI, RS3.2-PSI respectively; no significant differences among RS-127445 doses within saline or psilocybin conditions.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin (0.32 mg/kg) significantly increased HTR (expressed as the number of bouts) compared to saline-treated rats. This effect was not reversed by the 5-HT2BR antagonist RS-127445 (0.32, 1.0, or 3.2 mg/kg).

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR (expressed as the number of bouts) — a single behavioural measure.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total HTR counts over the session were analysed (Kruskal-Wallis on number of bouts); no within-session time course.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No sequential/transition analysis of HTR reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is explicitly not counted as an ethological behaviour.

B5_social.evidence: Rats were tested individually in the arena.

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR is an unconditioned drug-induced response.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: HTRs ... were manually scored by an experimenter blind to the study

B8_multivariate.evidence: HTR was analyzed by a nonparametric Kruskal-Wallis test — univariate only.

E1_environment_type.evidence: rats were placed in an Open Field arena (45 cm × 45 cm × 45 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: Bare open field arena; no refuge. Definitionally absent.

E3_bedding.evidence: The arena was thoroughly cleaned with 70% ethanol and dried between test sessions; no bedding.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in the arena.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in the arena.

E6_spatial.evidence: Open Field arena — single undivided space.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat tested alone in the arena.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water accessible in the arena.

D1_continuity.evidence: their behavior was recorded with a camera device for 30 minutes — single session on day 0.

D2_session_duration.evidence: recorded with a camera device for 30 minutes

D3_recording_days.evidence: HTR assessed only on day 0, immediately after injection.

D5_followup.evidence: HTR was not re-assessed ≥24 h after dosing.

assays.assay_description: Glass cylindrical tank (48 cm × 24 cm) with 30 cm of water at 24 ± 1°C. A 15-min unrecorded pre-test preceded each recorded 5-min test by 24 h. Tests were run on day 1 (FST 1) and day 21 (FST 21) after psilocybin; immobility, climbing and swimming were manually scored by a blinded observer using 5-s interval sampling.

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at 0.32 mg/kg of body weight

setup_habituation.evidence: A 15-minute pre-exposure session to the paradigm 1 day before the test session is used to elicit a consistent passive coping strategy (immobility) ... Unlike the pre-test, which was not recorded

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed into a glass cylindrical tank (48 cm × 24 cm) containing 30 cm of water ... the rats could not support themselves with their hind paws (FST cylinder = restrained per rubric).

food_restriction.evidence: No food was accessible in the swim cylinder during the 5-min recorded test; home-cage food ad libitum.

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water was accessible during the swim test (water is the test medium); home-cage water ad libitum.

time_to_assay.evidence: The FST was conducted 1 and 21 days after psilocybin administration (FST 1 and FST 21, respectively), with a pre-test performed 24 hours earlier (day 0 and day 20, respectively).

sample_size.evidence: the experiment utilized 8 experimental groups (n = 8 per group)

outcomes.summary: A single psilocybin dose (0.32 mg/kg) decreased immobility and increased climbing both 1 day and 21 days after administration, with no change in swimming. RS-127445 pretreatment dose-dependently reversed both effects (no block at 0.32 mg/kg; full block at 1.0 and 3.2 mg/kg).
outcomes.statistics: FST1 immobility: Antagonist F(3,53)=9.42, p<0.0001; Agonist F(1,53)=8.34, p<0.01; Interaction F(3,53)=12.77, p<0.0001. FST1 climbing: Antagonist F(3,54)=8.05, p<0.001; Agonist F(1,54)=11.50, p<0.01; Interaction F(3,54)=10.44, p<0.0001. FST1 swimming: Antagonist F(3,55)=1.83, p=0.15; Agonist F(1,55)=1.52, p=0.22; Interaction F(3,55)=0.23, p=0.88. FST21 immobility: Antagonist F(3,55)=5.50, p<0.01; Agonist F(1,55)=4.43, p<0.05; Interaction F(3,55)=7.41, p<0.001. FST21 climbing: Antagonist F(3,53)=5.33, p<0.01; Agonist F(1,53)=11.33, p<0.01; Interaction F(3,53)=8.96, p<0.001. Three-way Antagonist×Agonist×Day: F(3,52)=1.10, p=0.36 (immobility); F(3,51)=1.25, p=0.30 (climbing); F(3,54)=0.40, p=0.75 (swimming).
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin (0.32 mg/kg; vehicle pretreatment) produced rapid behavioral effects (FST 1) as shown by a decrease in immobility (p < 0.001) and an increase in climbing behavior (p < 0.001) compared to saline-treated animals with vehicle pretreatment. Both effects were dose-dependently reversed by pretreatment with RS-127445. A similar pattern was observed for FST 21.

B1_num_measures.evidence: the 5-minute test session was recorded for later scoring for immobility, climbing, and swimming

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Behavioral scores are presented as the number of 5-second intervals (bins) in which immobility, climbing, or swimming occurred during the 5-minute test — totals only, no within-session time course analysed.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis of FST behaviours reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility/climbing/swimming are escape-related measures in an artificial cylinder; FST immobility explicitly excluded.

B5_social.evidence: Each rat was tested alone in the swim cylinder (fresh water was used for each animal).

B6_cognitive.evidence: FST assesses stress-coping strategy, not learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The FST behaviors were scored manually by an experimenter blind to the study, using the modified sampling technique

B8_multivariate.evidence: Separate ANOVAs per behaviour; no multivariate or dimensionality-reduction analysis.

E1_environment_type.evidence: rats were placed into a glass cylindrical tank (48 cm × 24 cm) containing 30 cm of water at 24 ± 1°C

E2_shelter.evidence: Water-filled cylinder; no refuge. Definitionally absent.

E3_bedding.evidence: Water-filled glass cylinder; no bedding. Definitionally absent.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in the swim cylinder. Definitionally absent.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No objects in the swim cylinder.

E6_spatial.evidence: glass cylindrical tank (48 cm × 24 cm) — single undivided compartment.

E7_social_context.evidence: Fresh water was used for each animal; rats swam individually.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or drinking water accessible in the cylinder.

D1_continuity.evidence: The test and its pre-test session were performed twice: on day 1 (FST 1 ...) and day 21 (FST 21 ...) — two recorded test sessions.

D2_session_duration.evidence: the rats were exposed to a 5-minute swim ... the 5-minute test session was recorded

D3_recording_days.evidence: FST 1 (day 1) and FST 21 (day 21) were the two recorded days; the pre-tests (days 0 and 20) were not recorded.

D4_baseline.evidence: Unlike the pre-test, which was not recorded, the 5-minute test session was recorded for later scoring.

D5_followup.evidence: The FST was conducted 1 and 21 days after psilocybin administration — both ≥24 h after the single dose.

judge_notes: Three behavioural assays retained: Open Field locomotion, Head-Twitch Response, and Forced Swim Test. One candidate (qwen) merged OFT locomotion and HTR into a single entry; per the rubric, the same apparatus used for different behavioural domains counts as separate assays, so they were split (consistent with the other two candidates).
Rectal temperature and body weight measurements were dropped as purely physiological endpoints, not behaviour.

FST day 1 and day 21 tests (plus pre-tests) collapsed into one assay (different timepoints/phases of the same paradigm); D1 scored 'Multiple discrete sessions' and D3 = 2 recording days (pre-tests were explicitly not recorded, so D4 = No).
B1 corrected for OFT (3 measures → category '2-3', score 1; gemma had an internal score/value mismatch of 2) and for HTR (single measure → score 0; gemma scored 1 with value '1').
setup_restrain for FST set to 'yes' per rubric's explicit listing of FST cylinder as restraint (modal across candidates: 2 of 3).
Age scored 'not_reported': the paper gives only body weight (180–200 g), and the rubric forbids inferring age.
RS-127445 included as a second dosing entry since the rubric asks for every compound administered in behavioural experiments.
